description: OWS surface drawn. OWS Show gate (diAEControl.cpp L788): sta_owsLeft/owsRight = RET_SHOW only when val_power==3 and val_gear==1 and DiDcGetOwsLeftStatus/DiDcGetOwsRightStatus result in {1,2}. OWS getters read CycleSignal.RRadarDOWWarningLeftS (0x418/4.0-4.1) and RRadarDOWWarningRightS (0x418/4.2-4.3) gated by ETH_Status and online_418 companion frame. DOW warning values 1 and 2 set both sides visible. diOwsSurface SetData (diOwsSurface.cpp L130) then draws the left/right OWS anchor images at their designated canvas positions.

can.desc: HUD_Safe_Driving_Assistant_Fusion_Switch_Settings_S: ADAS fusion master on, ETH status asserted
online companion frame 0x418: enables DiDCgetter for OWS RRadar DOW signals
RRadar_DOW_Warning_Left_S = 1 -> DiDcGetOwsLeftStatus in {1,2}, left OWS shown
RRadar_DOW_WarningRight_S = 2 -> DiDcGetOwsRightStatus in {1,2}, right OWS shown

mem.desc: POWER_ON required by OWS Show gate
gear==1 required by OWS Show gate to enable OWS status output
